'''Darryll Silva''' (DeckTech author handle '''217'''; signs the post '''Shadow32''')<ref name="dt-22701">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22701 DeckTech post 22701], DeckTech (Darryll "217" Silva, 9 April 2002).
